title: Decoupled Knowledge Retrieval and Compact Memory Enable Reliable Lifelong Model Editing
title_zh: 解耦知识检索与紧凑记忆，实现可靠的终身模型编辑
abstract_en: Lifelong model editing requires continuously incorporating new facts into deployed large language models (LLMs) without expensive retraining or compromising existing capabilities. Memory-based editors offer an appealing solution by keeping the base parameters untouched, yet their practical use is hindered by linearly growing storage requirements and deteriorating retrieval performance as edits accumulate. To tackle these problems, we introduce BiSpace, a lifelong model editing framework that decouples memory retrieval from knowledge injection across two distinct representation spaces. BiSpace routes queries and identifies relevant edits in an external semantic space, while injecting the corresponding knowledge into the internal representation space of the LLM through sparse and storage-efficient updates. Extensive experiments show that BiSpace shrinks each entry's storage to only about 10.2% of the original and shows strong resilience to long edit sequences of up to 16K edits. On a more challenging benchmark, BiSpace further improves Overall Performance by more than 23% over existing methods. These results advance memory-based editing toward reliable long-term model maintenance at scale.
abstract_zh: 终身模型编辑旨在持续向已部署的大语言模型（LLMs）纳入新事实，同时避免昂贵的重新训练，并保留模型已有能力。基于记忆的编辑方法无需修改基座模型参数，但随着编辑不断积累，存储开销线性增长，检索性能也随之下降。为此，本文提出 BiSpace，在两个不同的表示空间中解耦记忆检索与知识注入：在外部语义空间对查询进行路由并检索相关编辑条目，再通过稀疏、节省存储的更新，将对应知识注入模型的内部表示空间。实验表明，BiSpace 将单条编辑的存储开销降至原来的约 10.2%，在多达 16K 次编辑的长序列中仍保持较强的稳定性。在更具挑战性的基准上，其总体性能（Overall Performance）较现有方法提升超过 23%。
key_points_zh: BiSpace 不修改基座模型参数，将知识检索与知识注入分离到外部语义空间和模型内部表示空间。
外部空间负责查询路由和相关编辑检索，内部空间通过稀疏更新注入对应知识。
单条编辑的存储开销降至原来的约 10.2%，且在多达 16K 次编辑的序列中仍保持较强的稳定性。
在更具挑战性的基准上，总体性能（Overall Performance）较现有方法提升超过 23%。
